Guided by the witch's dictionary, you head to Dragonspine to bring Albedo a brand-new assignment...

#### Go to Dragonspine

#### Talk to Albedo

**Paimon:** Hey, Albedo! Thought we'd find you here. Oh! Are you painting?

**Albedo:** Yes. I finally have a moment to myself, so I decided to pick up my brush and get some practice in.

- **Traveler:** Yeah, a lot of stuff has happened, huh...

**Albedo:** Indeed. Of course, thanks to your help, and my fellow Knights, that matter was resolved with little issue.

**Albedo:** In addition, I was able to complete the final task my master left for me.

**Albedo:** I couldn't have asked for a better outcome.

**Albedo:** Sucrose has been advancing swiftly in her studies, too. She can tackle many alchemy projects on her own now.

**Albedo:** The Knights of Favonius don't have any duties for me at the moment, either...

**Albedo:** No responsibilities, no tasks, no problems to resolve...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Are you okay?

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** You make that sound like a bad thing...

##### Shared continuation

**Albedo:** It's not. It just feels strange, not having to wrack my brain for solutions to all manner of problems...

**Albedo:** To be quite honest, I'm finding the idle life a bit... hard to get used to.

**Albedo:** I keep finding myself considering if there might be other issues that need solving.

**Albedo:** But, unfortunately for me, Mondstadt seems perfectly problem-free at the moment...

**Paimon:** There's nothing wrong with enjoying a bit of "me" time. Nothing good comes from working yourself to the bone.

**Paimon:** But if you're really that bored, you can come hang out with us! Paimon will teach you the true art of doing nothing!

**Albedo:** Haha, well, I suppose I should learn from the best.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** And if you're looking for trouble...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** I have a knack for finding it...

##### Shared continuation

**Paimon:** Traveler! Don't say things like that! You're gonna jinx us!

**Albedo:** New questions...

**???:** Strange to see you so idle, Albedo.

**???:** But considering that you've completed Master Rhinedottir's final task, I suppose you deserve a break.

**Paimon:** See! What did Paimon tell you? You ask for trouble, and here it comes!

**Albedo:** Sebas? What are you doing here?

- **Traveler:** Wait. You know this cat, Albedo?

**Albedo:** Yes. He's also one of my master's creations. I suppose that makes him a... family member, of sorts.

- **Traveler:** Ever the unconventional family you've got there.

**Sebas:** Hmph, don't you take that tone with me. I'll have you know that I alone keep that giant house in order as its butler.

**Sebas:** And yes, that has meant dealing with the assorted collection of vials and jars that you and Master use, washing them, drying them... All that work, done by one cat!

**Paimon:** Wait. You're a butler? How does that work? How do you handle vials and stuff without... y'know, thumbs?

**Sebas:** How do you stay afloat in mid-air?

**Paimon:** Huh? It's just something Paimon's always known how to do.

**Sebas:** Housekeeping is the same for me. Such facts are not up for question, and shall receive no answers.

**Paimon:** Hey! You're not allowed to say the same answer that Paimon said, you—

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** This cat belongs to Rhinedottir, Paimon...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Might be best if you...

##### Shared continuation

**Paimon:** Ugh. Sure, but don't expect Paimon to listen to his rambling...

**Sebas:** Allow me to get to the point, then. I'm here at Master Rhindottir's request. She has a message for me to pass along.

**Sebas:** Ahem!

**"Rhinedottir":** "Dearest Albedo, in regard to that task I set for you, your discovery of an answer that you can accept is most delightful."

**"Rhinedottir":** "Alas, once a problem is solved, mulling it over in one's head loses all meaning."

**"Rhinedottir":** "I'm sure the pendulum in your ever-whirring mind is swinging toward 'boredom' as we speak."

**"Rhinedottir":** "Might I suggest posing questions of your own, then?"

**"Rhinedottir":** "Cast 'the answers you know' aside. Instead, embrace 'the questions you don't.'"

**"Rhinedottir":** "After all, questions have always been more interesting than answers, and much better for passing the time."

**"Rhinedottir":** "I look forward to what questions you'll bring me upon our next meeting."

**"Rhinedottir":** "And should you come up with ones even I've never considered, all the better."

**"Rhinedottir":** "It's unlikely, of course, but do your best. And who knows? If you're lucky, you might just surprise me."

**"Rhinedottir":** "Oh, and don't attempt to create a 'self' whose sole purpose is to pose or ponder questions. I've tried it, and it doesn't work."

**"Rhinedottir":** "Lastly, I sent Sebas with a gift for you. Do keep it well, alright? Ah, and no need to feed him. He doesn't get hungry."

**Albedo:** As you instruct, Master.

**Sebas:** *coughing*... Master had quite a bit to say, I see... That really took a lot out of me, *coughing*...

**Sebas:** Well, I've passed the message along, so I shan't tarry in this frozen deathtrap for a second longer. I need to deliver a separate message to Mondstadt, at any rate...

- **Traveler:** Mondstadt?

**Paimon:** Huh, who else would have a connection to Rhinedottir in Mondstadt... Oh!

**Sebas:** Although his "birth" was rather recent, Master Rhinedottir has long foreseen what his "task" should be.

**Sebas:** But I digress. I shall be on my way. If I stay here a second longer, my tail might turn into an icicle.

**Sebas:** Your "gift" from Master Rhinedottir is on the table. Use it well.

**Paimon:** Y'know, Albedo... Your family gets more confusing by the second...

- **Traveler:** Yeah, now you're even adding a cat to the mix...

**Paimon:** Speaking of, would that cat really count as a family member? He called himself a butler and all, but...

**Albedo:** Master created Sebas long before me. By the standards of a normal family, that would make him my "elder," I suppose.

**Albedo:** Of course, my family could scarcely be considered "normal." So, by that logic, that type of relationship holds little meaning.

**Albedo:** At the same time, Sebas did look after me quite a bit back in the day, helping me tidy up various vials and jars... He even modeled for my sketches at times.

**Paimon:** Wait a second, the cat you drew today... That's him then, isn't it?

**Albedo:** Yes. Whenever I need to think, I turn to drawing, and let my subconscious take over. It always helps me sort my thoughts out.

**Albedo:** And, for some reason, I often wind up choosing a portrait of Sebas... I have drawn so many at this point that it's become second nature. Thus, this leaves my mind free to consider other things.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Now that you mention it...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** We've seen you draw a cat before...

##### Shared continuation

**Paimon:** Yeah, we thought it was just a random cat! Guess he was a way bigger deal than we thought...

**Albedo:** Well, now you know his real name. I can tell you more stories about him sometime, if you like.

**Albedo:** But right now...

**"Rhinedottir":** "The tree takes pride in its most perfect fruit — so complete, so flawless."

**"Rhinedottir":** "But you, O seed of dreams, do not settle for being the king of a universe confined to its flesh."

**Albedo:** ...I need to think.

**Albedo:** Oh, so you've met. I don't suppose Sebas told you of our relation to each other, did he...
